tools.name: AnvilToolkit

tools.name: AcuHarness (acuharness/)

tools.role: headless AnvilToolkit driver: batch, scan-objs (embedded-copy search), unpack-data, export-xml-dir, compile-xml, pack-data, export-glb, import-glb (vertex format v2), tex-import

tools.name: Syndicate.gfl
tools.version: AnvilToolkit file list for Syndicate (Kamzik123/AnvilToolkit-Resources); user-supplied
tools.role: names for AnvilToolkit; acuharness/build.ps1 copies the ACU_ATK_LISTS folder into the harness Lists folder

tools.name: Blender
tools.role: scripts/blender: prep_karin_original.py, fit_karin.py (fit, KP physics bones, --hide-band), face_rig.py, export_karin_lods.py (acs_weapon LOD GLBs, --split-normals), measure_glb.py, render_compare.py

tools.name: DirectXTex texconv
tools.version: user-supplied (version not recorded in the project)

tools.name: Windows embeddable Python
tools.version: python.org python-x.y.z-embed-amd64.zip (3.14.10 in the project); user-supplied
tools.role: bundled by make_release.py as python/ so the release runs without an installed Python or PowerShell

tools.name: forge, copy-scan, table, mesh, physics, install and release tools (scripts/)
tools.version: kit; Python 3.10+ (acs_install.py alone runs on 3.8+); numpy for acs_phys_skel / head_bones / glb_rotate / glb_info, Pillow for build_mod / make_meshes
tools.role: forge v27 index / extract, embedded-copy scan and table list, in-place install matched by ID and content with Steam / Ubisoft Connect / Epic discovery and a write-access check, BuildTable XML edits, payload builder for both twins with a vanilla recompile check, mesh pipeline for both twins, add-on physics skeleton, redeployable release zip with vanilla fingerprints and an embedded Python, CRC32 bone naming, GLB frame rotation and listing

runtime_boundary: Only the build PC's copy (ACS.exe linked 2016-08-16, labelled v1.51, forge v27, 40 forges); Steam / Ubisoft Connect / Epic copies were not run. Project builds made with the original scripts ran in game on the build PC: stage 1 / stage 2 (agent screenshots: title screen and in-world, both twins), v2 to v5 judged by the user from in-world play. Confirmed by the user: both twins replaced with physics and face working (stage 2, 2026-10-27), and v5 (twin tails on links 0 / 2 / 4, softer ears, knee band, split skirt normals: "looks OK", 2026-10-30). Rejected and superseded: v2 LocalOwnGravity ears / tails, v3 loose tails, v4 five simulated tail links. The release package was round-tripped on the build PC from an extracted copy with PATH limited to System32 (status, uninstall, install, status); the content-matching installer was checked on synthetic forges and on the real game (290 / 290 copies identical, a dry run without the dlc folders). The portable copies were checked on the build PC on 2026-10-31 (VALIDATION.md). Cutscenes (pre-rendered Bink videos stay vanilla), Jack the Ripper's old Jacob / Evie, the face rig in dialogue and other stores' copies are untested or not handled.
